method: Synthetic databases only; no cross-request cache. Instrumented application SQL, rows and values returned to Python, not physical disk reads.
limits: Progressive samples use 12, 48, 120 database months and one instrumented repeat while regression tests run concurrently.
Final reads use three repeats and median at each target period in completed 120-month databases; they are not directly comparable with progressive 12/48-month samples.
Connection setup is included in elapsed time, excluded from SQL counters. File bytes include retained WAL; logical page bytes do not.
Close-review pagination loads only the matching source blocks, but still reads and validates frozen manifest/index metadata; total cost is not constant.
Owner review is new in stage 7; baseline has no matching API. No invented zero baseline. No end-to-end 500 ms claim.
